name: dsrom-qelem-qs5f-cpr-tc-hm25-cl
purpose: S81.STA.LEAF.3 (S81-PINREG4 10-19, SAFE item 1): successor of the CLOSED ob2 view dsrom-qelem-qs5f-ob2-tc-hm25-cl-4b2f835cb, whose native audit (physical/s81_die_views/q_elem_qs5f_ob2/native_receipt.json) failed only the control pins busy 230.2 / fault 227.1 (launch) and go 216.7 (capture). CPR=1: kept pin registers for go/go_tag (input) and busy/fault (output); dsrom_q_pinflop_band_cpr.tcl = the closed out-flop band + the go/go_tag input pin flops placed at their pins. Everything else = the closed ob2 recipe (RSTP=1, ck-N, HM 0.025, outline 510.84x221.4, macros, pins).

bench.name: tb_qxpq_cpr_mut_late
bench.mutant: die schedule not updated (go at the ref time)

cycles_added: +1 go-command edge (go + go_tag captured by pin registers: the die issues the go command one cycle earlier, or the op starts one cycle later), +1 busy and +1 fault visibility cycle (private pin flops); 0 data cycles, every other output cycle-identical (tb_qxpq_cpr, Verilator 5.050). Handed to LEAD2-S81 INBOX (compiler / die schedule).

budget.reason: sheet ot_v41_rom_elem_q_qx_w10 names the die abstract's ports (cfg, go, r0 ...), not the element RTL's (cfg_v, xs_q0 ...): make_block_sdc.py would leave the RTL ports unconstrained; IO = the q-element's agreed derivation (launcher delays, physical/abi3/dsrom_qy_elem_io.sdc, outputs at the calibrated insertion via cl_signoff_sdc.sh); successor preserves all existing max windows and corrects only data-input minimum reference to actual measured H1 sender+50; reset excluded

notes: S81-PINREG4 10-19: not a critical prefix. Bench tb_qxpq_cpr PASS x3 seeds + 3 DIFF mutants on Verilator 5.050 (ot-epyc6), witnesses results/rtl/dsrom_qelem_pq_20261006/qxpq_cpr_1019/bench_5050. Frames binding this view must set .CPR(1) on the q instance and move the go command one cycle earlier.
